observed: 'Ricoh NZ is an active customer (Customer-20. Won (Signed Contract))'
why: Not a bug and nothing hard-coded. The per-source description recommends BUILTIN.DF, which returns NetSuite's DECORATED display value (prefixes the record type); '20.' is genuinely part of this account's status name. If it recurs the fix is per-source or a concept — never the generic engine.
evidence: SELECT DISTINCT BUILTIN.DF(entitystatus) FROM customer → 3 values, all prefixed

why: The system ALREADY knows this flag is unreliable: the 'project lifecycle status' concept records it, verified against 10k+ closed jobs. Named for projects, so it never surfaces on a customer question. Points at RETRIEVAL, not prompts.
evidence: 11 of ~5456 customers have isinactive='F' with status Inactive (6) or Lost (5)

observed: a cell emitted as {value, display, unit}
why: Consistent reasoning, not carelessness: the contract says a figure is {label, display, value}, so applying it to a cell was the obvious reading. The renderer printed [object Object]. The contract had two vocabularies for one idea and no stated boundary.
action: cell = the value; the COLUMN carries presentation, because the column is what names it
